Optimizing Memcpy Reads From DMA Memory - Arjun Mariyala - CppCon 2025
---

Reading from FPGA or NIC DMA buffers on the host isn’t the same as a normal memcpy. Cache snooping, memory attributes, and TLB pressure can all turn a simple copy into hidden latency, while unaligned access patterns may force unnecessary modify/update traffic. This talk shows how to potentially optimize DMA reads with huge pages, prefetching, and cache-aware access so data lands in L# predictably, without pathological snoop traffic or cache-set conflicts which may cut hundreds of nanoseconds from critical C++ packet pipelines.
